fieldDescription:
How much the Objects Analysis tooltip tells you.
Precise: derelict ships counted by class and size, fleets by name.
Normal: objects by the names the game shows, fleets counted as hostile, neutral and friendly.
Vague: only whether something is left to salvage, and how many fleets there are.
List the fleets in the current star system too.
Objects you have already found show in gray.

The ability can be clicked: the fleet slows down or stops for about 5 seconds (see Keep Sustained Burn), then every object in the star system is discovered and named on the map. Off: the ability only lists objects when you hover it.

On: the active scan halves the fleet's burn level, and Sustained Burn stays on.
Off: the fleet stops for the scan, and Sustained Burn turns off.
What each active scan uses up from your cargo.
How many units each active scan uses up.

What the active scan does to the planets in the star system.
Preliminary: every planet gets a preliminary survey.
Full: every planet is fully surveyed, as if you surveyed it yourself (without its survey data to sell).
None: planets are left alone.
